# Third-party assets

Do not place third-party packages here blindly.

Use `Docs/FREE_ASSET_SOURCING_2026.md` as the source manifest.

Recommended structure:

- Quaternius/Characters/Base
- Quaternius/Characters/OutfitsFantasy
- Quaternius/Animations
- Quaternius/Environment/MedievalVillage
- Quaternius/Props/Fantasy
- Quaternius/Nature
- Mixamo
- Kenney/UI
- UnityAssetStore/MagicEffectsFree
- UnityAssetStore/MagicCircleURP
- UnityAssetStore/FreeStylizedURPShaders

Before release:
- preserve applicable license/EULA information;
- keep a THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES record;
- do not redistribute standalone source asset packs.
